documents.text:
id: study-rct-01
design: rct
Trial registration: pre-registered NCT04567890.
Methods: participants were randomised 1:1 with allocation concealed in sequentially numbered opaque envelopes; outcome assessors were blinded.
Analysis: intention-to-treat, n=214.

id: study-rct-02
design: rct
Trial registration: pre-registered NCT07894561.
Methods: participants were randomised 1:1; blinding of outcome assessors was not reported.
Analysis: per-protocol, n=88.

id: study-obs-01
design: cohort
Design: retrospective cohort, not randomised.
Methods: allocation concealment is not applicable; no blinding.
Analysis: propensity-score adjusted, n=1204.
